description: Implementation of FreeType's OpenType validation module, including functions for loading and validating font tables, and service interface definitions.

methods.name: otv_load_table
methods.description: Loads a font table given a face and tag, allocating memory for the table data.

methods.name: otv_validate
methods.description: Validates various OpenType font tables such as GDEF, GPOS, GSUB, etc., using a validation context.

methods.name: otvalid_get_service
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenType validation service interface.
